prospect.sectionSubtitle: The "Three Highs and One Low" of the Hearing Industry

highPrevalence.title: High Prevalence
highPrevalence.desc: Hearing loss affects over 20% of the global population. With aging populations and modern lifestyle changes, the number is projected to reach 2.5 billion by 2050, with 700 million having moderate or worse hearing loss. China's hearing aid market potential will exceed 120 billion yuan

highHarm.desc: Hearing loss severely impacts the current and future quality of life for the elderly. Without timely intervention, the loss amounts to 981 billion USD, equivalent to the Netherlands' annual GDP

lowAwareness.title: Low Awareness
lowAwareness.desc: If hearing-impaired individuals receive timely hearing aid fitting and rehabilitation services, the vast majority can have their hearing compensated and participate in social activities like normal-hearing people, improving their quality of life

groups.label: User Low Awareness
items: 67% of seniors don't know their hearing has declined or been lost
Only 7.4% of ear disease patients in China have received hearing tests
Only 8% of hearing-impaired seniors over 65 received hearing tests in the past year

groups.label: Government Low Awareness
items: Child subsidies are well-established, but senior subsidies only exist in Beijing/Shanghai/Guangdong/Fujian
WHO 2017 Global Deafness Prevention Resolution requires otology to extend to grassroots and communities, but China's progress is not ideal
WHO requires hearing aid adoption rate to reach 50% by 2030; China still has a huge gap

advantages.sectionSubtitle: Good Track + Government Support + Strong Brand

track.title: Good Track
track.desc: Benefiting from population aging, with sustained high growth. By 2050, moderate or worse hearing loss population will reach 700 million, and China's hearing aid market potential will exceed 120 billion yuan

lineChart.title: China Hearing Aid Market Size Trend (2000-2030)

marketStatus.title: China Hearing Health Market Status
marketStatus.desc: Internal neglect, external product and technology monopoly. Chinese hearing-impaired users have low adoption rates, poor product service experiences, and high purchase costs
marketStatus.imageAlt: China hearing health market status - hearing clinic fitting scene
marketStatus.footnote: 1/3 of seniors 65+ have hearing disorders. By 2030, moderate hearing loss will reach 100M

policy.title: Favorable Policies
policy.desc: The state has included hearing aids in the key development track of rehabilitation assistive devices, with 14 ministries jointly issuing a special three-year action plan, providing targeted policy support across the entire chain — core technology research, industrial platform building, financial credit support, medical insurance linkage, first-set certification, and talent training system

items.title: Industrial Planning Support
items.desc: 14 departments jointly issued the "Three-Year Action Plan for Capacity Expansion and Quality Improvement of Rehabilitation Assistive Devices Industry (2026-2028)", listing hearing aids as one of the 6-8 core sub-industries to be strengthened, supporting enterprises to break through key technologies and list financing, with the goal of exceeding 500 above-scale rehabilitation assistive enterprises by 2028.

items.title: Hearing Health Action
items.desc: In 2024, the "Elderly Hearing Health Promotion Action (2024-2027)" was launched to advance hearing screening, intervention, and science popularization across all age groups, improving industry service capacity.

items.title: Centralized Procurement Price Reduction
items.desc: National subsidy policies have been introduced, significantly reducing hearing reconstruction costs for hearing-impaired groups and driving the trend toward universal access to hearing aids and related assistive devices.

items.title: National Standard Upgrade
items.desc: Starting July 1, 2026, the new national safety standard for hearing aids will be officially implemented, unifying internationally aligned technical testing requirements, regulating industry access, and ensuring product quality and safety.

awareness.title: Raising National Hearing Health Awareness
awareness.desc: With the continuous rollout of National Ear Care Day science popularization and the widespread adoption of CDC ear health guidelines, from active hearing screening by seniors to attention to noise-induced hearing loss among young people, national hearing health awareness is undergoing a key shift from "passive neglect" to "active intervention"
